parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same defect: create_ticket still passes the old keyword attempts=1 after the rename to max_attempts, so it lands in **fields as a body field, the request falls back to the default of 3 attempts, and the non-idempotent ticket POST can be retried, creating duplicate tickets. Description B adds detail about TransportError and the vendor API, but the root cause and location match.
